item.title: Join us
item.description:
We keep no membership lists and collect no fees. We work in tasks: someone writes a letter, someone translates, someone gathers data, someone stands with a banner.

What you can do

  • Collect data about your own case. Application date, decision date, authority — that is enough to feed the statistics .
  • Translate. The site runs in Polish, Russian, English, Ukrainian and Belarusian. Each new translation means dozens more people who will understand their rights.
  • Write and send letters. Use our templates — they are ready to go.
  • Document responses. Got a reply from an office? Send it to us and it will join the response archive .

item.title: Reminder (ponaglenie) for an authority's inaction
item.description:
A ponaglenie is the simplest and most effective step when your case is stuck. You file it with the higher-instance authority, but through the authority handling your case.

  • For a voivode’s decision the higher authority is the Head of the Office for Foreigners.
  • The authority has 7 days to forward the reminder together with the file.
  • The higher authority decides within 7 days.

In the 14 cases we tracked, a reminder moved the decision forward by roughly 3 months. In 4 cases it changed nothing.
